name: VR4Autism
summary:
VR4Autism is an educational virtual reality experience developed to support children on the autism spectrum through engaging, hands on learning activities.
The game includes multiple modes designed to improve motor skills, cognitive development, and learning through play:
Object Grasping Exercises: Hand tracking based activities that help children practice fine motor skills by grabbing and interacting with virtual objects.
